zh.title: 紳寶公布A3-001無人僚機全尺寸模型
zh.summary: 紳寶揭示A3-001無人僚機；預計2030年前試飛
body: 紳寶（Saab）於8月22日在瑞典林雪平馬爾姆空軍基地舉行的瑞典國防軍慶祝航空展上，公開了一款新型無人作戰飛機的全尺寸模型，型號為A3-001。
這款低可觀測飛機被設計為與紳寶獅鷲（Gripen）戰機共同作戰的自主僚機，可用於執行電子戰、壓制敵方防空系統以及在高度爭端空域進行精確打擊等任務。
紳寶表示計劃在2030年前試飛具有戰機特性的無人驗證機。A3系統則代表了瑞典在2030年代中期可能跟進的後續方案。
紳寶並未公開A3-001的航程、速度、載荷、發引擎或武器容量等性能資料。目前該機概念屬於概念階段。

en.title: Saab unveils A3-001 Gripen wingman concept in full-scale model
en.summary: Saab shows A3-001; says uncrewed demonstrators planned before 2030
body: Saab unveiled a full-scale model of a new uncrewed combat aircraft, designated A3-001, at the Swedish Armed Forces' Jubilee Air Show at Malmen Air Base in Linköping on 22 August.

The low-observable aircraft is designed to operate as an autonomous partner alongside the Gripen, taking on missions such as electronic warfare, suppression of enemy air defences and precision strikes in heavily contested airspace.
Saab said it intends to fly uncrewed demonstrators with fighter-like characteristics before 2030. The A3 system represents what could follow in the mid-2030s.
Saab has not disclosed the A3-001's range, speed, payload, engine or weapons capacity. For now, A3-001 is a concept rather than a flying aircraft.
